records.jp: うーん。<CR>全然当たらない……
records.en_original: Ugh. I can't hit a thing!
records.en: Ugh. I can't hit a thing!

records.jp: こんなに練習してるのに……<CR>うーっ、悔しいです
records.en_original: I practiced so hard, too... How frustrating!
records.en: I practiced so hard, too... How frustrating!

records.jp: 私が代わりにやろうか？
records.en_original: Want me to give it a shot?
records.en: Want me to give it a shot?

records.jp: ……ありがとうございます。<CR>助言だけで大丈夫です
records.en_original: I appreciate the offer. But I can do this.
records.en: I appreciate the offer. But I can do this.

records.jp: これはわたしと的の戦い。<CR>手だし無用です
records.en_original: This battle is between me and the target alone. I do not require assistance.
records.en: This battle is between me and the target alone. I do not require assistance.

records.jp: （西部劇かな？）
records.en_original: (Is that a line from a western?)
records.en: (Is that a line from a western?)

records.jp: （手を貸したいところだけど、<CR>多分自分で取りたいんだろうな）
records.en_original: (I wanna help, but I get the feeling she wants to do this on her own.)
records.en: (I wanna help, but I get the feeling she wants to do this on her own.)

records.jp: （向こうから言われるまでは見守ろう）
records.en_original: (I'll just wait for her to say something.)
records.en: (I'll just wait for her to say something.)

records.jp: よし、休憩終了！
records.en_original: All right, break time is over!
records.en: All right, break time is over!

records.jp: 待っててくださいね！<CR>絶対に射止めてみせますから！
records.en_original: Just you wait! I am definitely going to get it!
records.en: Just you wait! I am definitely going to get it!

records.jp: 頑張れー！
records.en_original: You can do it!
records.en: You can do it!

records.jp: うーん、やっぱり当たらないなぁ
records.en_original: Ugh. Maybe I can't do this after all...
records.en: Ugh. Maybe I can't do this after all...

records.en_original: (Oh.)
records.en: (Oh.)

records.jp: （もしかしてフォームを変えた方がいいかもしれない）
records.en_original: (Maybe adjusting her form would help.)
records.en: (Maybe adjusting her form would help.)

records.jp: もうちょい脇締めた方がいいかも。<CR>で、銃をもっと顔にくっつけて
records.en_original: You might want to bring your arms in a little. And hold the gun closer to your face.
records.en: You might want to bring your arms in a little. And hold the gun closer to your face.

records.jp: 見てて思ったんだけど、銃の固定がちょっと甘くて、<CR>狙いが定まってないのかも
records.en_original: It looks like you're not holding the gun steady, which is throwing your aim off.
records.en: It looks like you're not holding the gun steady, which is throwing your aim off.

records.jp: ありがとうございます。<CR>自分だけでやってると、そういうことに気づかなくて
records.en_original: Thank you. I wouldn't have noticed that on my own.
records.en: Thank you. I wouldn't have noticed that on my own.

records.jp: 初めは申し訳ないなって思ってたんですけど<CR>やっぱりつきあっていただいてよかったです
records.en_original: I felt bad asking you to come along at first, but I am glad that you did.
records.en: I felt bad asking you to come along at first, but I am glad that you did.

records.jp: いえいえ～。<CR>また何か気づいたら伝えるね
records.en_original: Don't worry about it! I'll let you know if I notice anything else.
records.en: Don't worry about it! I'll let you know if I notice anything else.

records.jp: きゃっ
records.en_original: Eep!
records.en: Eep!

records.jp: 撃つ時にここをこうしてるじゃん。<CR>こういう風にした方が撃ちやすいと思う
records.en_original: You're doing this when you shoot. It'll be easier if you do it like this.
records.en: You're doing this when you shoot. It'll be easier if you do it like this.

records.jp: あっ、はい……
records.en_original: O-oh, okay...
records.en: O-oh, okay...

records.jp: 感覚掴むために、このまま撃ってみる？
records.en_original: Wanna shoot like this until you get a feel for it?
records.en: Wanna shoot like this until you get a feel for it?

records.jp: いえ！　大丈夫です！
records.en_original: No! I've got it!
records.en: No! I've got it!

records.jp: てか私がお手本見せた方が分かりやすいか。<CR>別の的狙って
records.en_original: It'd be easier for me to just show you. I'll aim at a different target.
records.en: It'd be easier for me to just show you. I'll aim at a different target.

records.jp: よかったらぜひお願いします
records.en_original: I'll take all the help I can get.
records.en: I'll take all the help I can get.

records.jp: おっけー
records.en_original: Okay!
records.en: Okay!

records.jp: あれ？
records.en_original: Huh?
records.en: Huh?

records.jp: （うわ、あんなに偉そうに教えて外すとか<CR>めっちゃ恥ずかしいんだけど）
records.en_original: (Agh, I can't believe I missed after all that talk. How embarrassing...)
records.en: (Agh, I can't believe I missed after all that talk. How embarrassing...)

records.jp: ごめん、もっかいやっていい？
records.en_original: Sorry, do you mind if I take one more shot?
records.en: Sorry, do you mind if I take one more shot?

records.jp: もちろんです
records.en_original: Go right ahead.
records.en: Go right ahead.

records.jp: わぁー！　すごいです！
records.en_original: Wow! That was amazing!
records.en: Wow! That was amazing!

records.jp: なんとか面子が立った……
records.en_original: Phew, I almost made a fool of myself there...
records.en: Phew, I almost made a fool of myself there...

records.jp: 充分ですよ！　<CR>二発撃っただけで当てるなんて！
records.en_original: You only needed two shots to hit the target, though! That's great!
records.en: You only needed two shots to hit the target, though! That's great!

records.jp: 褒め上手だねえ、詩帆さんは
records.en_original: You've got a way with words, Shiho.
records.en: You've got a way with words, Shiho.

records.jp: こ、これは二連撃ちという技でね
records.en_original: Th-this is a technique called the double tap.
records.en: Th-this is a technique called the double tap.

records.jp: 一発目で目標物を揺らして、<CR>二発目で落とすってやり方なんだよ
records.en_original: You want to shake the target with the first shot and knock it down with the second.
records.en: You want to shake the target with the first shot and knock it down with the second.

records.jp: へー、そんな方法があるんですね
records.en_original: Wow, I've never heard of that!
records.en: Wow, I've never heard of that!

records.jp: （よし、次さえ当てれば……）
records.en_original: (All right, now I just need to hit it this time...)
records.en: (All right, now I just need to hit it this time...)

records.jp: ごめんごめん、さっきのは間違い。<CR>これは三連撃ちと言って……
records.en_original: Oh sorry, I meant to the, uh...triple tap technique...
records.en: Oh sorry, I meant to the, uh...triple tap technique...

records.jp: へー、色んな技があるんですね
records.en_original: Wow, there are a lot of different techniques, aren't there?
records.en: Wow, there are a lot of different techniques, aren't there?

records.jp: （詩帆さんからの目線が痛い……）
records.en_original: (Shiho's eyes are piercing my soul...)
records.en: (Shiho's eyes are piercing my soul...)

records.jp: フラグメント「<CLGR>%s<CLNR>」を<CR>手に入れました
records.en_original: Obtained <CLGR>%s<CLNR> Fragment.
records.en: Obtained <CLGR>%s<CLNR> Fragment.
